en.headline: Tram derails on Shau Kei Wan East Street and mounts pavement
en.dek: A tram left the tracks early Monday near ground-floor shops, with nearly half the carriage scraping onto the walkway; police are investigating the cause.
body: A tram derailed on Shau Kei Wan East Street in the early hours of Monday, mounting the pavement and coming close to a ground-floor shop.

Police received a report from a resident shortly after 1am that a tram had left the tracks and that overhead cables appeared loose. Firefighters confirmed the tram had scraped onto the walkway, with nearly half the carriage off the rails and near the shopfront.

Officers sealed part of the narrow street while firefighters checked the tram, cables and nearby buildings for risks such as electrical faults or falling objects. Tram company staff were seen inspecting the tracks. Police are investigating the cause and whether anyone was injured. A similar derailment occurred in the same area in November 2025.

zh.headline: 箕箕灣東大街電車出軌 近半車箱鑲上行人路
zh.dek: 周一凌晨箕箕灣東大街一輛電車離開路軌，近半車箱鑲上行人路並接近地舖，警方正調查成因。
body: 箕箕灣東大街周一凌晨發生電車出軌事故，車箱鑲上行人路並接近路旁地舖。
警方今早約1時接獲住戶報案，指一輛電車出軌，架空電纜亦疑松脫。消防員到場確認電車已偏離路軌並鑲上行人路，近半個車箱衝上路旁，車身幾乎貼近地舖門面。
警方一度封鎖部分路面，消防員檢查車箱、電纜及附近建築，防範漏電或物件墜下。電車公司人員在場檢查路軌。警方正調查事故原因及有否有人受傷。2025年11月同一地帶亦曾發生類似出軌。
更正：中文版本字元已修正。
